response.text: Your goal is to fix your n8n workflow so the full file of about 5,000 rows lands every night in Google Sheets without failing due to rate limits, including retries and a Slack message if it still fails. To achieve this, I will handle each requirement: importing a CSV each night, appending them to a Google Sheet, stopping the Google Sheets node from failing partway with 429 Too Many Requests, ensuring the full file lands every night, and adding retries. First, I will analyze your existing n8n workflow and Google Sheets node configuration to identify the rate limit trigger points during the import. Second, I will implement batching or rate-limiting logic within the n8n workflow to handle large data imports without exceeding Google Sheets API limits. Third, I will configure built-in error handling and automatic retry mechanisms for the Google Sheets node inside your n8n workflow. I did nearly this for a sales operations client: lead entry dropped from about 2 hours a week to under 10 minutes. Which Slack channel should the failure alert notifications be sent to?
